about: s2e03 per-episode edit choices (S13 editor, 26 Nov, first edit). Inputs: shots.json (S7 clarity remap), script.{hi,en}.json, voice/manifest.jsonl + review.json, sound/cues.json, sound/manifest.jsonl, frames/review.json.
notes: First edit (S13, 26 Nov). No slates: all 27 generated frames have an approved row in frames/review.json, and the six second framings (s05, s08, s14, s18, s19, s28) render from approved sources with their shots.json moves.

measure.pause_min_s 0.22 (default 0.30): en l15 'We don't raid on what's heard / over a fake thana's phone, SI Joshi.' had no split pause, so build_subs split it mid-line and the first cue read at 17.4 graphemes/s (subs en failed validation). The take has a 0.24 s pause at 'phone,'; at 0.22 s it becomes a split, and the cue reads under 17. The setting is global (no per-line subtitle-split override exists yet, a toolsmith item), so it also splits hi l03, l05, l14, l30 and en l12, l34 at their comma pauses (more, shorter cues; no picture change in hi; en shots from s16 on move 2 frames later). hi l08's cut word is now placed by grapheme spread (it was whisper) at the same frame.

Lead s08 66 frames (silent_lead 36): sfx_keypad_call_end (about 1.15 s of tone) starts on the s07/s08 cut and the 1.0 s of bulb hum after it ends before l28 (cue sheet: shorten the hold, never cut the tones). Tails: s21 30 (b6's 0.8 s hold on her after l17), s25 30 (the train horn after l32), s26 45 (b8's 1.5 s: holster unbutton, wood knock), s33 45 (b10's 1.5 s hold, then hard cut with all sound).

Long set-ups held on their moves, as S7's remap asks: s08 about 12.5 s hi / 13.7 s en (second framing of s02, three lines), s16 about 9 s, s25 about 8 s. Over the 8 s set-up guide; flag for screening.

su9 starts on the cut into s02 and holds 3.0 s into s03 (s02 is under 2 s in both cuts); not flagged. The cue sheet's 'black for a breath' before the buzz is not cut: the buzz starts on frame 0 with s01.

Voice fx: dsp lines through the built-in 'phone' chain; Bhaiyaji's speaker lines l03-l06 through 'small_speaker' (highpass 250 Hz, lowpass 5 kHz, a short aecho), loudness-matched. sfx_keypad_call_end goes through the same band (no echo). lyr_phone_line_hiss sits under l13, l15, l16, l17 only.

Sound: every placement written here from the cue sheet (it has no place entries). amb_talkies_lobby (8-29 s window, crossfaded loop, -7) is cut into six pieces for its ducks: -4 under l03-l06 and l17, -8 from l27 through the hold. Crickets (highpass 300 Hz, -9) and the clock (-4) go out for b3 (s08-s09) and return at s10, follow the same ducks, and the clock is +3 in b5's silence. mus_tension_note use 1 is five 12 s pieces of its steady 2-14 s stretch with 15-frame crossfades, from s17 (2 s fade-in) to 1 s after l32 (b7 now ends on l32, not l20), with -4 under l17; use 2 from s32 at trim 9 s, -4 from l27, hard cut at s33's end. The horn starts after l32 (S7 kept about 1 s for it), low-passed 2.5 kHz, -6 under l21 and out by l21's end. Gains are starting points from the manifest levels; nothing has been listened to.
